title: TenantBranding
description: Strict schema for tenant branding attributes (colors, logos, typography) preventing arbitrary injection.

primary_color.description: Primary brand color in 3 or 6 hex digit CSS format

secondary_color.description: Secondary brand color in 3 or 6 hex digit CSS format

logo_url.description: Absolute URL to the tenant institutional logo (HTTPS preferred)

favicon_url.description: Absolute URL to the tenant favicon
